note: Le mieux est l'ennemi du bien; Voltaire gives it as a wise Italian's saying, so the line is a proverb in his mouth. It also stands at the head of the article Art dramatique in Questions sur l'Encyclopédie (1770), folded into later editions of the Dictionnaire philosophique; the 1764 Dictionnaire had no such article, which is why the bank placed it wrongly until 3 October 2026.

evidence: The second line of La Bégueule, quoted with the couplet by the Wiktionnaire entry for le mieux est l'ennemi du bien and by dicocitations (citation 158799), both dating it 1772.
